## Highlights

- **Team chat**: tag two or more agents (`@claude @cursor …`) and they talk it through: they split the work, review each other's files and push back where they disagree.
- **The same agent twice**: `@claude @claude`, or **+** in the Team menu, seats an agent more than once (Claude #1, Claude #2), each with its own model.
- **A model for every agent** in the Team menu, and **⚡ Fast mode** for agents left on Default (Cursor runs Codex 5.3 Low Fast).
- **Command approvals**: when Claude wants to run a command, the chat asks you first: *Allow*, *Always allow in this chat* or *Deny*. The shield in the chat header switches between *Ask me*, *Always allow* and *Refuse*.
- Each step an agent takes shows live under its reply, and past chats are kept in the history menu.
- Agents get 15 minutes per turn instead of 3, and a turn that runs out of time or quota says so.
- Your OpenRouter key is stored encrypted, and GitHub sign-in only opens github.com links.

**Updating:** if you have 0.2.1-beta or newer, the gift icon at the bottom left installs this one. From 0.2.0-beta or older, download it below once.

**macOS:** the app isn't notarized by Apple yet. Move it to Applications, open it once, then click **Open Anyway** in *System Settings → Privacy & Security* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Vulgr.app`).
